items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM pregame then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue; played and produced (8/10 for 68+TD).
items.why: ETR summary + Schefter/Rapoport confirmation of active; optimism from Saturday feel-better reports.
items.implication: WR1 lock with Adams out; full target share expected.
items.opportunity: Primary routes/targets in depleted Rams WR room.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then officially INACTIVE (quad, missed 4th straight); limited practice only.
items.why: ETR + Rapoport unlikely/early then confirmed inactive by Schefter.
items.implication: Continue stashing; return Week 8 possible after full practice.
items.opportunity: Lead back role for backup (Allen) in good matchup.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle/high-ankle) downgraded to OUT vs Bengals; close but misses 3rd straight, expected next week.
items.why: Official downgrade; ETR listed OUT; limited practice.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game downgrade, Flowers/Andrews impacted.
items.opportunity: Streaming QB options elevated; Zay Flowers volume may hold but efficiency drops.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring, also slide-related) actually hurt but not certain; ETR watching with Tracy.
items.why: Levitan player-specific: thinks hurt unlike Gibbs certainty.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 8; role as lead may shrink if lingering.
items.opportunity: Tracy or others if Skattebo limited; reverse prior lead-back bump.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would be tilting if serious from smart play.
items.why: Levitan direct assessment post-ETR watch list; no lasting concern indicated.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring return).
items.why: ETR weekend summary; Rapoport noted Smith OUT, Barkley Q but expected.
items.implication: Eagles pass game thinned; Goedert/AJB elevated if Saquon limited.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining WRs/TE; Saquon workload if active.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated/expected to play (IN) after layoff; ETR listed IN.
items.why: Schefter activations list; Rapoport confirmed Packers activate.
items.implication: Workload question post-layoff; Berry hated for rust.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps if fully ramped; handcuff value drops.

items.text: Berry LOVES A.J. Brown (usage/matchup vs CHI); volume RBs Warren/Hubbard/Irving; Kraft TE buffet vs DET; Saquon if active; Coleman roster/lead snaps.
items.why: Per-player Love/Hate: strong usage/matchups, TE feast, volume backs.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Coleman upgrade confirmed post-game snaps.
items.opportunity: Target share/snap expansion in favorable spots.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; day-to-day.
items.opportunity: Mason/others temporary if sits, but low concern.

items.text: Seahawks/Broncos/Vikings/Packers potential suitors for Jonathan Taylor at deadline; Jadarian Price (chest) eligible Week 8 unsure status.
items.why: Levitan on Schefter deadline names; SEA needs weapons beyond JSN.
items.implication: Taylor value spike if traded to contender; Price handcuff monitor.
items.opportunity: Potential role expansion for Price if Taylor moves.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33/36 routes (2nd game w/o Rice); high volume but never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games career.
items.why: Levitan charted Mahomes dropbacks; ceiling note on historical production.
items.implication: Volume WR3/flex but capped upside without efficiency leap.
items.opportunity: Route share expansion w/o Rice; monitor for breakout or fade.

items.text: Jets WRs w/ AD Mitchell back: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 52 season routes), Mitchell 18 on 33 Geno dropbacks.
items.why: Levitan post-game route data; Cooper efficiency standout as 30th pick.
items.implication: Wilson remains clear WR1; Cooper stash/upside in deeper leagues.
items.opportunity: Wilson high route share; competition for secondary targets.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad) and Kenny Gainwell (hip) returned to game; watching but no lasting flags noted.
items.why: ETR Sunday watch list; both returned.
items.implication: Full roles intact; low concern for next week.
items.opportunity: Maintain snap shares; no beneficiary shift.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze (shadow), Josh Downs, Kelce (tough D), Jacobs post-layoff, Skattebo (brutal spot).
items.implication: Sit or fade; Jacobs rust risk material.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/IN but still hated for workload.
